# Pearl Primus Multipurpose Contracting Ltd — pearlprimus.oagroupng.com

Pearl Primus Multipurpose Contracting Ltd is the commercial contracting arm of OA Group Nigeria — providing contract administration, project facilitation, investment management, and commercial ventures for Nigerian government, private sector, and institutional clients.

## Company

- Type: Multipurpose contracting and project facilitation company
- Registered in Nigeria (CAC RC: [CAC: RC-XXXXXX])
- BPP Registration: [BPP REG: XXXXXX]
- Tax Clearance: Current — FIRS

- Phone: +234 806 165 0349
- Email: info@pearlprimus.oagroupng.com
- Group: A Member of OA Group Nigeria (oagroupng.com)

## Capability Areas

- Contract Administration: tender preparation, BPP compliance, contract documentation, payment certification, variation management, final accounts
- Project Facilitation: stakeholder coordination, regulatory navigation, PMU support, donor-funded project management, interface management
- Investment Management: joint ventures, investment structuring, commercial portfolio management
- Commercial Ventures: supply and distribution, commercial facilitation, partner ventures

## Sectors

- Government: Federal and State (BPP framework)
- Oil & Gas Support
